name: print-social-pink-and-green-blob-product-launch-post
title: Bubblegum pink post with green blob paths, matcha drink cutouts and justified caps
whatItIs: A pink 4:5 post with thick winding dark-green blob shapes running through it. A white round candle sits at the top right, a matcha latte and whisk bowl cutout at bottom left, an italic caps title at left and a large justified paragraph in cream caps at lower right.
whatItMeans: Playful and sensory; pink and green feel like a matcha treat.
techniques: Use organic winding shapes as a path between cutouts.
Choose a complementary pink and green pair.
Set the body as large justified caps with wide spacing.
Add italic caps for the small title.
bestFor: Product launch posts for candles, food and beauty

vocabulary.definition: A thick organic shape that leads the eye.
Uppercase text aligned on both edges.
